title: THE NEEDED-ITEM GLOW
why: His yes to suggestion 31, with his answer that it is the container that glows because items on the ground are boxes. When an unfinished contract still needs an item (the extraction cards that ask you to carry out a Circuit Board, an Optic, a Servo or a Data Core), any shut container that holds one now glows gold on the ground, with a small diamond over it, so a contract steers where you search. The item has the same gold edge on its cell in the backpack and on its row in the pickup stack when it comes out of the box. It goes dark the moment the item is out of the box, the card is done, or the box is opened. What the lift carried up with you does not count toward a card, and so it does not count here. There are no contracts in the DEMO, so nothing glows there. Nothing that drops, is found or is paid changes.
now: A box that holds an item your contract needs glows gold, and so does the item.
